{
  "name": "ship-check",
  "displayName": "Ship Check",
  "version": "0.1.4",
  "description": "A development verification board: shows which tests, builds and type checks really ran, how they ended, and whether the result still matches your code.",
  "author": {
    "name": "panyuti-ai",
    "email": "panyouting1124@gmail.com"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/panyuti-ai/ship-check-mods",
  "repository": "https://github.com/panyuti-ai/ship-check-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "tests",
    "build",
    "typecheck",
    "verification",
    "dashboard"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "extra_checks": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Extra checks",
      "description": "Your own check commands, one per entry, written as kind=command. Example: lint=npm run lint",
      "multiple": true,
      "default": []
    },
    "extra_ignored_paths": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ignored paths",
      "description": "Folders or files whose changes should not make a result Stale. Example: generated",
      "multiple": true,
      "default": []
    }
  }
}
